why: Re-check of the public notebooks on 2026-09-21 00:30 UTC, after f10_omw_lock and f10_v53_lock were frozen: prvsiyan republished two notebooks (20 Sep 21:42 UTC) with a new agent, sha 5fbb75c9...: One More Wheat byte-for-byte (modulo line endings) plus a 16-line visible-price guard that keeps the step-91 wheat when its visible price is below 31 (Apache-2.0; the author reports +28 per game on 128 paired games). Every other new notebook is a copy of Pipe-16 (kaibaur) or an analysis without a new agent (leoprovorov: shop control is possible with the hidden seed but not measured as profitable; fixed vs flexible play of the top teams).
screen_note: Official engine, both seats. The guarded public agent beats plain One More Wheat 11/1 by exactly 30 coins. f10_omw_lock beats it 10/2 (world 7571 lost by 9 coins); f10_v53_lock beats it 8/4. f10_omwg_lock (the same guard under the Lab lockstep layer) adds +30 in every world against every opponent without changing any sale chain: 12/0 against the guarded agent, 12/0 against gluzdov_omw, pipe16 and metav4, 6/6 against v53 and f10_v53_lock exactly like f10_omw_lock (losses shrink by 26-44 coins), 11/1 head to head against f10_omw_lock (the only loss is the seat-asymmetric world 7576).
rule: Hash frozen before the holdout. Official engine, paired against our own frozen candidate f10_omw_lock on identical opponents/seeds/seats. The change is a constant +30 coins, so it can only move W/L in worlds decided by less than that; the gate therefore asks for no W/L regression plus a measured margin gain: total paired score >= 0, score against the guarded public agent >= 75% and not below the control's, head to head against the control >= 50%, mean paired margin gain >= +15 coins over all games, no opponent with a paired delta below -2.0 (one world, both seats), no reported errors/fallbacks, every callback < 1000 ms. The Kaggle kernel then repeats the paired comparison on four fresh seeds against Metav4-family opponents (total > 0 and no opponent below the control). If it passes, f10_omwg_lock replaces f10_omw_lock as the Metav4-family slot; f10_v53_lock is unchanged. Registered before the run.
